objective: Support many concurrent authenticated users without browser disconnects cancelling work or user state leaking/blocking another user, while keeping the production runtime isolated from Oracle CI.

production_cace_backend: canonical workspace versions and experiment state

isolation_rules: Every workspace/run/control request is authorized server-side.
A principal cannot enumerate/read/mutate another unauthorized tenant workspace/run.
Browser entitlement/role claims are not authoritative until server-validated.
No process-global active experiment/current user state for multi-user requests.
Proof/scientific artifacts remain scoped to authorized workspace/run.

browser_session.cross_tab_coordination: BroadcastChannel when available; server remains source of truth

workspace_concurrency.conflict_behavior: typed version conflict; never silently overwrite
workspace_concurrency.merge_behavior: Gemini may offer rebase/merge UI; Oracle/CACE validates final graph

event_delivery.fallback: bounded polling to Production CACE backend with exponential backoff and jitter

failure_recovery.worker_failure: FAILED or RECOVERY_REQUIRED; never invent completion
failure_recovery.duplicate_retry: idempotency key reconciles same accepted mutation/run
failure_recovery.production_backend_restart: restore durable workspace/queue state; interrupted runs use explicit recovery/restart semantics

base44_credit_rules: Cache membership/entitlements at session bootstrap and refresh only on meaningful changes.

may_label_multi_user_ready_only_if: queue is durable and interactive API remains responsive

cloud_run_rule: Cloud Run is excluded from multi-user session/workspace/run traffic; it is reserved for Monero payments only.
